title: execute 200 response (SPEC.md §14.6)
description: Status mapping is normative in §14.6: 200/executed → proposal executed; 200/rejected → failed with reason; 5xx or malformed → failed (never retried once answered); timeout/network → bounded retry with the same idempotency_key, then failed with outcome-unknown reason.

result.description: Any JSON value; carried in ProposalStateChanged.result.
